subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support allow `updateConfiguration` plus explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default, per-account, linked-device, and container-mode semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The code path and upstream API are clear, but the default behavior and metadata boundary decide whether OpenClaw changes existing Signal account settings or risks untrusted preview metadata entering agent context.

options.title: Opt-in explicit preview pass-through
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limitations, and does not fetch metadata in OpenClaw.

options.title: Defer to security design
options.body: Keep the feature blocked until the link-preview prompt-injection issue settles the metadata boundary for all channels.

options.title: Default-on Signal previews
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default while preserving an escape hatch, accepting a larger compatibility and security-review burden.

recommendation.title: Opt-in explicit preview pass-through
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limitations, and does not fetch metadata in OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already provided public implementation context on this issue.
